task: Review completed runs and report what actually went wrong, not what plausibly could. Start with (runs/list {"limit" 20}) as an intermediate observation. Choose one candidate run and call (runs/failure run-id {"limit" 1000}); this single question returns the run, diagnostics, generated programs, effective preludes, and conservative program-to-error relationships. Return the final report unless one specifically named fact required by the schema is missing. Use runs/conversation only when the complete model exchange is needed, runs/activity only for exact capability or provider activity, runs/source only for exact compiled or generated source, and runs/overview only for retained result metadata. Never join raw record families yourself. Treat every runs/* or repo/* result as intermediate and use return only for the final schema-shaped report. Return a JSON object with "summary", "findings", "recommended_next_action", and "rationale". Every evidence item has exactly "provider", "snapshot_hash", "resource", and positive "positions" fields. For run evidence, copy provider as private-history, resource as the run ID, the appropriate trace_snapshot_hash or inspection_snapshot_hash (or snapshot_hash on conversation/source), and sequence positions from the exact items supporting the claim. For workspace evidence, copy provider, snapshot_hash, relative-path resource, and source line positions from repo/* unchanged. Do not cite incomplete evidence as complete, invent positions, infer an error relationship stronger than the returned relationship, or treat one occurrence as a pattern. If the bounded question cannot establish the required fact, recommend gather-more-evidence and name it.
